title: Concurrency: a second login of the same user ends the first session
description: Template (T6.6). The same user logs in twice, in two browser contexts that share no cookie. Expected policy (GeneXus conventions, section 2): the NEWEST session wins and the older one is sent back to the login page the next time it asks the server for a page. If your application refuses the NEW login instead, the login gate of the second user fails: invert the two halves (see templates/routines/README.md). Needs the target profile flag maxSessionsPerCredential >= 2, otherwise the run is refused with 400 TooManySessionsForCredential (the lock exists to stop two runs from kicking each other out; this routine is the one that does it on purpose). Replace every REPLACE_* value.

lintSuppress.reason: The logout is the teardown of the included login routine, which runs once for each actor.
